archimate:Goal.name: Revenue raising for health financing to provide coverage (e.g., taxes, insurance contributions): Secure sustainable, equitable health sector funds.
archimate:Goal.documentation:
Revenue raising refers to the collection of funds from sources such as taxes, insurance contributions, and donor grants to sustain the health sector. It represents the foundational financial input required to provide comprehensive healthcare coverage to a population.
Its purpose is to secure sustainable and equitable funding streams that reduce reliance on out-of-pocket payments at the point of care. This ensures that the health system has the necessary capital to operate effectively and expand service reach to underserved areas.
Example: A digital tax collection interface that automatically allocates a percentage of payroll taxes directly to a national health insurance fund.
